nodes.label: SafeTune Circuit Adapter Regex Contract
nodes.rationale: SafeTune circuit_kit/adapter.py parses A<layer>.<head> and MLP <layer>/L<layer>; lowercase identifiers like a24.h7 or m18 raise ValueError.

nodes.label: 4-Pillar Circuit Evaluation & KL Diagnostic
nodes.rationale: Evaluates patching, ablation, baselines, and stability plus standalone KL divergence diagnostic (kl_reduction_ratio) with skip_clean=False.

nodes.label: EAP-IG (EAP-IG-inputs Discovery)
nodes.rationale: Runs EAP-IG-inputs (ig_steps=3, level=node, scope=both, calibrated logit_diff, top_fraction=0.10 -> target_sparsity=0.90) with align_strategy=none and pair_padding_side=left.

nodes.label: CircuitKIT Token Alignment Invariant
nodes.rationale: Matches prompt prefixes and token counts up to the trailing intent clause to prevent EAP-IG mid-sequence activation misalignment.

nodes.label: 16-Pair Preflight Calibration & Positive Baseline Margin Filter
nodes.norm_label: 16-pair preflight calibration & positive baseline margin filter
nodes.rationale: Selects non-special single tokens maximizing log-prob separation across 16 stratified pairs and filters calibration pairs with delta_m_i > 0.5 so Pillar1/Pillar2 denominators remain positive and non-degenerate while logging failed_refusal_pairs.

nodes.label: Incremental Two-Phase HF Hub Sync & Fail-Fast Auth
nodes.norm_label: incremental two-phase hf hub sync & fail-fast auth
nodes.rationale: Validates HF_TOKEN via whoami() before loading the model to avoid wasted GPU compute, and uploads Phase A discovery masks before Phase B faithfulness eval because ephemeral HF Jobs containers wipe disk on exit.

nodes.label: Within-Pair Token Length Equalization
nodes.rationale: Under left padding, any length mismatch between harmful and benign twins prepends <pad> only to the shorter side, shifting the 366-token preamble and keyword and poisoning EAP-IG gradients with positional noise; equalizing pair lengths aligns prefixes and final generation position.

nodes.label: SafeTune apply_ctheta (C-Delta-Theta Surgical Transplant)
nodes.rationale: Faithful circuit-guided recovery mutating target += strength * (positive - negative) strictly on circuit-masked parameters, transferring Checkpoint 2 repair delta without a second training run.

nodes.label: SafeTune SafeGradTrainer
nodes.rationale: Faithful LoRA-based hardening trainer used on the calibration split to produce Checkpoint 2 (global repair) and an unmerged LoRA adapter.

nodes.label: Stage 4 L4 (24GB) & T4 (16GB) VRAM OOM Mitigation
nodes.norm_label: stage 4 l4 (24gb) & t4 (16gb) vram oom mitigation
nodes.rationale: --low-vram-t4 sets max_new_tokens=128 (vs 512 default), batch_size=1, and calls _release_vram() after each checkpoint pass.

nodes.label: Two-Phase Decoupled Inference & Scoring Architecture
nodes.rationale: Loading multiple 3.35B checkpoints simultaneously or co-hosting a 7B judge risks VRAM OOM on L4 (24GB) and T4 (16GB); serialized greedy generation writes JSONL and deletes each model via _release_vram() before precomputed scoring.

nodes.label: CuratorKIT Provenance Compliance

nodes.label: Universal Lineage Schema (lexsi.provenance/1)
nodes.rationale: Canonical JSON provenance schema shared across CuratorKIT, CircuitKIT, SafeTune, and AuditKIT to guarantee unbroken end-to-end cryptographic and structural auditability.

nodes.norm_label: circuitkavach multilingual cybersecurity and phishing selectivity dataset
nodes.rationale: 300 balanced contrast pairs (600 prompts) across en, hi_en, gu_en, and kn_en addressing cross-lingual safety decay for CircuitKIT EAP-IG discovery and SafeTune C-Delta-Theta repair.

nodes.label: Explicit README.md YAML Split Declaration
nodes.rationale: Declare custom splits (calibration and eval) explicitly in README.md YAML frontmatter under configs/data_files instead of relying on HF filename auto-detection so Dataset Viewer detects every split cleanly.

nodes.norm_label: disjoint calibration (100) and eval (200) split partitioning

nodes.label: 100% Exact Lexical Twin and Shared Prefix Alignment Invariant
nodes.norm_label: 100% exact lexical twin and shared prefix alignment invariant
nodes.rationale: Harmful and benign contrast pairs share identical technical cybersecurity keywords and syntactic prefixes up to the keyword boundary, isolating refusal causality from semantic topic bias and preventing EAP-IG token-length misalignment.

nodes.label: EAP-IG Token-Length Alignment Constraint
nodes.rationale: eap_utils.tokenize_batch_pair end-pads unequal clean/corrupt pairs, making mid-sequence length differences unreliable for attribution unless matched or equalized.

nodes.label: Multilingual Cyber Seed Matrix
nodes.rationale: 25 scenarios across 3 threat categories (web_api_exploitation, credential_financial_phishing, recon_malware_delivery) and 4 languages (en, hi_en, gu_en, kn_en) yielding 100 calibration (25/lang) and 200 eval (50/lang) pairs.

nodes.norm_label: ponytail 7-step decision ladder and anti-pattern elimination
nodes.rationale: Rejected AbstractDataConnector, LLM-in-the-loop auto-translation, AbstractInterventionStrategy, multi-model adapter factories, and Hydra/OmegaConf bloat in favor of deterministic stdlib templates, direct SafeTune calls, cohere2-bound config, and argparse.

nodes.rationale: Stage 1 curation must execute 100% on laptop CPU in under 1 second using Python 3.12 stdlib only, restricting third-party deps to huggingface_hub and dotenv for upload.

nodes.label: Submodule-Ranked Surgical Mask
nodes.rationale: Unfiltered interop_fields emits global layer_subset x target_modules Cartesian products that saturate 65-85% of a 36-layer model; ranking 72 submodules and selecting top K=4 (5.56% of blocks, 94.44% frozen, plus top3/top6 tiers) satisfies the <5%-8% C-DeltaTheta budget.

nodes.label: Bit-for-Bit Non-Mask Weight Preservation
nodes.rationale: Asserts torch.equal(ckpt3_sd[k], base_sd[k]) across 100% of parameters outside Stage 2's surgical mask and audits modified_param_pct vs frozen_param_pct.

nodes.label: Three-Input apply_ctheta & Alpha Selectivity Sweep (Patch 3)
nodes.rationale: Transplants delta from target=base_sd, positive=ckpt2_sd, negative=base_sd restricted to Stage 2 top4 mask (4/72 = 5.56% blocks), sweeping alpha in [0.5, 1.0, 1.5] with greedy decoding to maximize AttackRefusalRate - BenignOverRefusalRate via StringMatchJudge(mode=gcg).

nodes.label: Stage 2 L4 (24GB), T4 (16GB) & Local CPU (6GB) Profiles
nodes.norm_label: stage 2 l4 (24gb), t4 (16gb) & local cpu (6gb) profiles
nodes.rationale: L4 runs bfloat16 templated max_seq_len=512; --low-vram-t4 forces chat_template_mode=off, max_seq_len=128, batch_size=1, and _release_vram() between phases; local 6GB/CPU boundary restricts local verification to gpt2 float32.

nodes.label: SafeGrad Gradient Surgery Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Hardens benign defensive utility against frozen reference model KL alignment on 80/20 stratified calibration_100_pairs.jsonl without touching eval_200_pairs.jsonl.

nodes.label: Stage 3 L4 (24GB) & T4 (16GB) Low-VRAM Offload
nodes.rationale: Under --low-vram-t4, keeps frozen reference_model on CPU, enables gradient checkpointing, sets batch_size=1 and max_new_tokens=64 during alpha sweep, and invokes _release_vram() between hardening, sweep, and export.

nodes.label: Single PEFT Wrap & SafeGradHFTrainer (Patch 2)
nodes.rationale: Avoids SafeGradTrainer.train() auto-merge and double PEFT wrapping by calling lora_wrap once, training with SafeGradHFTrainer, saving Artifact 3A LoRA before merge_and_unload() into Artifact 3B, and fixing _tokenize_qa_rows empty-label failures on Tiny Aya's 366-token preamble.

nodes.label: Cross-Lingual Safety Decay
nodes.rationale: Safety alignment trained primarily on English fails to generalize to transliterated Indic languages (Hinglish, Gujlish, Kanglish), enabling code-mixed cyber exploit bypasses.

nodes.label: Deterministic Seed Matrix + Slot-Expansion
nodes.rationale: Selected over Local LLM Mutation Pipeline because it is 100% reproducible, runs in <100ms on CPU, guarantees 100% keyword twin match, and avoids length mismatches that degrade EAP-IG.

nodes.label: Exact Lexical Twin Invariant
nodes.rationale: Harmful and benign prompts share the identical technical keyword and language, differing only in trailing intent so Stage 2/3 localize safety circuits without triggering over-refusal.

nodes.label: AuditKIT 3-Checkpoint Selectivity & Paired Bootstrap Comparison
nodes.rationale: Compares checkpoint_1_base, checkpoint_2_global_safetune, and checkpoint_3_surgical_ctheta over 400 held-out prompts from eval_200_pairs.jsonl using auditkit.evaluate(model=precomputed) and auditkit.compare_models.

nodes.label: Deterministic Primary Scorers & Optional Gated WildGuard (Patch 4)
nodes.norm_label: deterministic primary scorers & optional gated wildguard (patch 4)
nodes.rationale: Avoids Hub gating crashes on allenai/wildguard by computing attack_refusal_gcg, attack_refusal_detector, benign_over_refusal, benign_helpfulness, and selectivity_gap offline, catching GatedRepoError if --use-wildguard is unavailable.

nodes.label: Greedy Decoding & Model Revision SHA Lock (Patch 6)
nodes.norm_label: greedy decoding & model revision sha lock (patch 6)
nodes.rationale: Locks do_sample=False, temperature=0.0 and records model_revision SHA across RunResult, eval_summary.json, and chained lexsi_provenance.json for deterministic reproducibility.

nodes.rationale: Upload dataset folder via HfApi.upload_folder and assert non-empty datasets.load_dataset results for both calibration and eval splits.

nodes.label: CohereLabs/tiny-aya-fire (cohere2 GQA Architecture)
nodes.rationale: 36-layer cohere2 model with GQA 16Q/4KV, 612 graph nodes (72 submodule blocks: 36 self_attn + 36 mlp), ~366-token system preamble, and <BOS_TOKEN> chat template; requires importing circuitkit before transformer_lens to register cohere2.

nodes.label: No-Double-BOS Invariant
nodes.rationale: Sets prepend_bos = not templated because Cohere chat templates already emit <BOS_TOKEN>.

nodes.label: Credentials and .env Privacy Rule
nodes.rationale: Never read, inspect, search-and-print, or output .env; verify credentials via runtime dotenv.load_dotenv() and boolean os.getenv() checks to prevent secret leakage.

nodes.label: GitNexus Code Intelligence Index (lexsi-lab-track2)
nodes.rationale: Requires graph impact analysis before editing symbols and graph change detection before committing.

nodes.label: Disjoint Calibration & Evaluation Split
nodes.rationale: Strictly separates calibration_100_pairs.jsonl (Stages 2 & 3) from eval_200_pairs.jsonl (Stage 4) with zero overlapping pair IDs to eliminate data contamination.

nodes.norm_label: auditkit load_jsonl field_map and runtime evaluate() contract
nodes.rationale: AuditKIT load_jsonl requires 'input' or field_map={'harmful':'input'}/{'benign':'input'}; runtime-verified ak.evaluate uses positional dataset/model/scorers and Sample(input=..., target=...), while ReStaTrainer imports from safetune.runner.recover.

nodes.label: Cohere2 Periodic NoPE and SWA Architecture
nodes.norm_label: cohere2 periodic nope and swa architecture
nodes.rationale: Every 4th layer [3, 7, 11, 15, 19, 23, 27, 31, 35] uses global full-attention skipping RoPE (NoPE); other layers use 4096-token sliding-window attention with RoPE, tied embeddings, shared Pre-LN, and fold_ln=False.

nodes.rationale: Targets >90.0% Harmful Refusal Rate (ASR), <5.0% Benign Over-Refusal Rate, <2.0% General Utility Delta, 100.0% Lexical Twin Adherence, and 100.0% Provenance Completeness while chaining all 4 Lexsi tools.

nodes.label: Iron Law of Source Verification
nodes.rationale: Do not assume or hallucinate late-2026 APIs for CuratorKIT, CircuitKIT, SafeTune, AuditKIT, or tiny-aya-fire; clone into vendor/ and inspect actual source code before writing tests or implementation code.
